reference_host.audio_output: Windows default SDL playback endpoint; device identity withheld

rows.scope: Exact Complete Edition image reaches the recognizable title/frontend through the canonical unpatched guest-selected route.
limitations: Bink decode/playback fidelity is not verified.
First-run OOBE and account selection are not verified.

rows.scope: A progressed local save loads across fresh Release processes; autosave overwrite and transactional recovery are verified.
limitations: The title exposes autosave rather than a manual-save command.
Clean native first-run save creation and persistent player-name editing remain outside the alpha claim.

rows.scope: Digital controls, sticks, triggers, focus recovery, hotplug, and latest-active arbitrary-slot routing are physically verified.
limitations: Prompt glyphs remain Xbox 360-style.
Remote software may not forward rumble even when local rumble works.

rows.scope: Model-agnostic SDL wheel admission, configurable input, latest-active wheel/gamepad switching, and bounded title force feedback are verified on one T300.
limitations: Only the Thrustmaster T300RS is physically verified.
Other SDL wheels are configuration-compatible, not physically certified.
Curb force is title-submission dependent and intermittent; exact Xbox 360 force fidelity is not claimed.
KI-022 remains open: successor routing suppresses duplicate-endpoint churn, but centering can still disappear while the wheel remains active.

rows.scope: D3D12 output covers frontend, HUD, city, day/night, rain, reflections, motion, shadows, particles, and garage scenes at stock timing.
limitations: KI-013 colored vehicle-light amplification remains open.
KI-015 alpha coverage shimmer/noise remains open.
KI-016 minimap flicker remains open.
KI-019 exposed neon projection geometry remains open.
KI-020 white-paint overexposure remains open.
KI-021 is closed on the v0.10.0.1 successor after physical and machine non-black Photo Mode verification; the historical tested build remains affected.
Only the NVIDIA RTX 3090 D3D12 path is physically verified.

rows.scope: Music, ambient, voice, engine, collision, and UI classes are present; long XMA/XAudio/SDL output and default-device recovery are verified.
limitations: Exact mix parity is not claimed.
KI-017 tracks music stopping while ambient SFX remain.
XMP-selected system music is unavailable.

rows.scope: One continuous Release process crossed all project-defined major city coverage zones and returned to Hollywood/Sunset.
limitations: This does not cover every road, collectible, event, or campaign item.

rows.scope: Representative head-to-head and multi-event series, traffic, police observation, checkpoints, finishes, rewards, and repeated race completions are covered.
limitations: This is not an exhaustive event/opponent/campaign matrix.
KI-024 is closed by an owner-confirmed active delivery transition and five-minute stability window; full delivery completion is not claimed.

rows.scope: One purchase, exterior item, exhaust, paint, vehicle switch, autosave, and fresh-process reload lifecycle is verified.
limitations: Not every vehicle, part, tune, paint, or garage is covered.

rows.scope: Pause, focus loss, minimize/restore, controller hotplug, audio endpoint recovery, and external window close are covered across bounded runs.
limitations: OS suspend/hibernate, display-adapter removal, and graceful full guest teardown are not claimed.
KI-023 records one host NVIDIA device removal during a Sunshine crash storm; it is contained by classification, not claimed fixed by the title.
KI-025 tracks the missing runtime Alt+Enter and double-click fullscreen toggle; startup fullscreen remains configuration-controlled.

rows.scope: Reached achievement/stat/voice/service calls fail or degrade deterministically without fabricated online state.
limitations: Multiplayer, leaderboards, Rate My Ride, voice transport, and retired Social Club unlock services are unavailable.
The canonical build does not grant retired-service vehicles as cheats.

rows.scope: Historical mixed free-roam/race coverage and a ReXGlue v0.10.0.1 two-hour frontend stage passed; one current-artifact 60-minute mixed-gameplay acceptance process is prepared.
limitations: M6-014 remains open until the current 60-minute mixed-gameplay process physically passes.
The historical frontend and current gameplay executables differ; no same-artifact, continuous three-hour, legacy five-stage, or ten-hour monolithic run is claimed.

rows.scope: The exact Complete Edition image and South Central city data load in covered routes.
limitations: Full campaign completion, every event, every vehicle, every cutscene, every unlock, and all on-disc Complete Edition content are M7 scope.
